text:
marta: Heads-up — Acme Analytics hitting intermittent 403s on /v1/embeddings since they rotated SSO keys last night. Ticket TICKET-5421. Only embeddings calls fail; generation/chat still works.

sam_customer: Confirmed. Batch job hitting 403 with 'insufficient_scope'. Happened right after we pushed the SSO key rotation.

marta: Repro steps from customer:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_acme_XXXX\" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing_scope:embeddings"}
```

devon: Can you paste the token claims or output from `rdwctl token inspect`? Need to confirm which scopes are present.

marta: Pasted decoded claims (redacted):
`{iss: \"redwood\", sub: \"svc_acme\", scopes: \"generation rerank\"}`
— note: `embeddings` is missing.

ingrid: Looks like the provisioner job that handles SCIM->servicekey mapping hit an error 02:12 UTC yesterday. There's a failed import attempt for tenant `acme-tenant-17`. Investigating whether the SCIM CSV parsing dropped the last scope.

devon: Short-term workaround: re-issue the service key from console or run quick sync: `rdwctl provision --tenant acme-tenant-17 --force-sync` — that will push the correct scope set immediately.

ops-oncall: Marking P1 due to customer batch jobs blocked. Eng-infra hipchat/ops loop engaged. Will patch provisioner to be tolerant of trailing whitespace in scope lists. ETA ~3h.

deploy-bot: :rocket: deploy started: infra/provisioner v1.4.3 -> v1.4.4 (rollback safe).

marta: Confirmed with the customer: new key issued via UI fixed the embeddings calls. They are unblocked. Thanks. :relieved:

ingrid: Root cause summary: CSV import path used `split(',')` and then trimmed whitespace only for columns 0..n-2; when downstream tooling had a trailing space on the last column the final scope token was saved without trim and later rejected by the auth service matcher. Bug introduced in provisioner v1.4.3. PR #987 adds robust trimming, unit test, and a retry on transient SCIM failures.

devon: Postmortem + rollout plan: patch in prod, backfill affected tenants' service keys where needed, and add monitoring alert for 'missing embeddings scope' regression.

marta: I'll update TICKET-5421 and notify Acme's TAM.

ops-oncall: Follow-up tasks: add e2e for SSO rotation, add `rdwctl` quick-check to detect unscoped keys, and schedule a 1-week sweep for similar tenants. :thumbsup:

sam_customer: Thanks, team — appreciate the quick fix.

ingrid: PR merged, will monitor for 2h before closing.

marta: Closing note: customer confirmed stability after 24h. Will file a short customer-facing summary for CS to share. :white_check_mark:
